title: video for etsy shop
description:
🎬 Short Etsy Shop Video Script (15–20s)
🎵 Background Music

Soft, upbeat, creative (lofi / cute aesthetic)

🎞 Scene 1 (0–3s)

Visual: Soft pastel background, sparkles, watercolor splash
Text on screen:
✨ Welcome to NexorPrintsCrafts

🎞 Scene 2 (3–6s)

Visual: Digital designs appearing (stickers, planners, printables)
Text:
🎨 Creative Digital Designs Made for You

🎞 Scene 3 (6–10s)

Visual: Someone using a tablet / printing / crafting
Text:
✂️ Print. Create. Craft with Ease

🎞 Scene 4 (10–14s)

Visual: Finished products (cute crafts, organized planners, aesthetic prints)
Text:
💡 Perfect for DIY Lovers & Creators

🎞 Scene 5 (14–18s)

Visual: Brand logo / your banner
Text:
💖 Designed with Passion
🛍 Shop Now on Etsy

🎞 Final Frame (18–20s)

Text (center):
NexorPrintsCrafts
✨ Create Something Beautiful Today ✨

🎯 Pro Tips (Very Important)
Keep video under 20 seconds (Etsy prefers short)
Use vertical format (1080x1920) or square (2000x1500)
Add subtle animation (zoom, fade, sparkle effects)
Use your brand colors (pink + teal) for consistency
